acceptedFindings.title: Analysis is unbound and exploratory, not suitable for confirmatory claims
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The analysis was not pre-registered, and the method was not chosen via a binding spec. P-values and confidence intervals from such an analysis are prone to overinterpretation.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either re-run with a pre-specified analysis plan or downgrade all claims to strictly hypothesis-generating, and remove significance language.

acceptedFindings.title: Proportional hazards assumption not tested
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Cox model coefficients are unreliable if the proportional hazards assumption is violated. No Schoenfeld residuals or other diagnostic test is reported.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Perform Schoenfeld residuals test for each covariate and globally, and present results. If non-proportional, consider time-dependent covariates or stratified model.

acceptedFindings.title: Analysis is exploratory and lacks pre-specified protocol
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without a pre-specified analysis, p-values and confidence intervals are unreliable for confirmatory inference, and the risk of data dredging is high.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Bind the run to a pre-registered AnalysisSpec and method selection, or clearly present results as exploratory with no confirmatory interpretation.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify that stats-run.json has 'binding.status' equal to 'unbound' and 'resultPosture.status' equal to 'exploratory_standard_table'.

acceptedFindings.title: Cohort construction and missing data not reported
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: No inclusion/exclusion criteria, no flowchart, no handling of missing data other than complete-case N=240. Potential selection bias if missingness is not random.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a STROBE-style flowchart, describe missing data patterns, and consider sensitivity analysis or multiple imputation.

acceptedFindings.title: Variable definitions, units, and coding absent
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Interpretation of HRs requires knowing (e.g., treatment comparison groups, age scale, severity scoring). Lack of this makes results uninterpretable.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Define each variable precisely, including reference categories for categorical variables and units for continuous ones.

acceptedFindings.title: Analysis is not reproducible with provided artifacts
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: No raw data, analysis script, or container is provided. The hash inventory is insufficient for third-party reproduction of results.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Include data (de-identified) and full analysis code in a runnable environment, or provide a Docker container with all dependencies.

acceptedFindings.title: No model diagnostics for influence, outliers, or overall fit
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Cox model may be sensitive to outliers or non-linear effects. Without checks (martingale residuals, dfbetas, C-index), the model may be misspecified.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Calculate and report martingale residuals to assess functional form, dfbetas to check influence, and a concordance statistic.

acceptedFindings.title: Proportional hazards assumption not verified
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Violation of the PH assumption can bias hazard ratio estimates and invalidate confidence intervals. The Cox model requires verification.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report Schoenfeld residuals test (e.g., cox.zph) and visual diagnostics, and consider alternative models if PH fails.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Confirm that diagnostics.json does not contain a 'schoenfeld' key and that manuscript.md does not mention PH testing.

acceptedFindings.title: Complete-case analysis without missing data exploration
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: If missingness is related to exposure, outcome, or covariates, complete-case analysis can introduce selection bias.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Describe amount and patterns of missingness, perform sensitivity analyses (e.g., multiple imputation), and justify complete-case approach if missing completely at random.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that manuscript.md lacks a description of missing data and that stats-run.json shows completeCaseN equal to rowCount without any missingness analysis artifacts.

acceptedFindings.title: Confounders chosen without justification
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Including inappropriate covariates or omitting relevant confounders can bias the treatment effect estimate. Causal interpretation requires a DAG or expert knowledge.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a directed acyclic graph (DAG) or clinical rationale for covariate selection, and consider sensitivity analyses for unmeasured confounding.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that manuscript.md does not contain any justification for the inclusion of 'age' and 'severity' as covariates.

acceptedFindings.title: No literature context or comparison to prior findings
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The paper lacks any references, which is needed to interpret the magnitude and direction of associations in context of existing evidence.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Conduct a brief literature review and discuss how these results compare, especially for treatment and age effects.

acceptedFindings.title: Hazard ratios reported without clinical interpretation
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Although p-value caution is stated, the HRs themselves are not interpreted clinically (e.g., age HR=1.02 per year may be negligible).
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add a discussion of the clinical or practical significance of each effect size.

acceptedFindings.title: Manuscript claims absence of estimates and report when both exist
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Inaccurate self-assessment undermines trust in the manuscript and may indicate a templating error.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Remove contradictory statements and ensure manuscript accurately reflects available artifacts.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Confirm that manuscript.md contains the text 'No estimate-like records were available for p-value/effect-size checks' while stats-run.json includes an 'estimates' array.

acceptedFindings.title: No survival curves or model diagnostic plots provided
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Visual presentation of survival curves by treatment group and residual checks aids interpretation and transparency.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Generate Kaplan-Meier curves and at least a Schoenfeld residual plot for the Cox model.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that figures.json reports 0 figures and figure-qa.json shows 0/0 figures passed.

acceptedFindings.title: P-values reported without clinical or practical significance discussion
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Statistical significance does not imply clinical importance, especially with small sample sizes. The hazard ratios should be interpreted in absolute terms or with clinical context.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add discussion of effect sizes, confidence interval precision, and clinical relevance.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify that manuscript.md lacks any interpretation beyond p-values and hazard ratios for clinical applicability.

finding.title: No checks for sparse data or extreme values
finding.whyItMatters: Sparse covariates or few events per variable could lead to unstable estimates; standard rule of thumb is 10+ events per predictor.
finding.actionableFix: Check events per predictor (140 events, 3 predictors is adequate) but also check for zero cells or extreme values.
finding.deterministicVerification: Verify that stats-run.json contains no per-variable summary statistics or outlier flags.

rejectedFindings.reason: Low-severity single-reviewer finding kept as advisory but not accepted for automatic repair.
